subject: [PATCH v4 1/4] mm/huge_memory: scale thp_underused() to the folio size

reviews.author: Kiryl Shutsemau (Meta)
reviews.summary: Approved the patch with a Reviewed-by tag, indicating that it meets kernel coding standards and can be applied as-is.

2026-11-03.patch_summary: This patch updates the thp_underused() function to scale its threshold based on the size of the folio, rather than assuming a fixed PMD-sized folio. This change is necessary because future patches will add anonymous mTHP folios to the deferred split list, which would break the current assumption.
